slices.focus: Safety reset moves from proposal to active pilot with evidence from contractor field notes
slices.summary: Derek's first-year safety reset transitions from a review into an active pilot program after he compiles contractor write-ups, attendance sheets, and field notes from Tasha Freeman that reveal consistent unsafe patterns. His proposal includes more ladder work, repeated lockout-tagout practice, and short weekly check-ins for at-risk apprentices. Ron Belski pushes back hard, calling the check-ins 'hand-holding,' but the evidence is strong enough that the pilot launches despite resistance. Derek wrestles with how to protect the core while letting the old guard save face.
